description: Source code for a Git-related utility handling log tree visualization, decorations, and diff display.

methods.name: decorate_get_color
methods.description: Returns the color code for a decoration type if color output is desired.

methods.name: add_name_decoration
methods.description: Adds a decoration to an object with a specific type and name.

methods.name: get_name_decoration
methods.description: Retrieves the decoration associated with an object.

methods.name: match_ref_pattern
methods.description: Checks if a reference name matches a pattern, considering wildcards.

methods.name: ref_filter_match
methods.description: Determines if a reference name passes include/exclude filters.

methods.name: add_ref_decoration
methods.description: Adds decorations for references based on their namespace and type.

methods.name: add_graft_decoration
methods.description: Adds graft decoration for a commit graft.

methods.name: load_ref_decorations
methods.description: Loads decorations for references, including grafts and ref namespaces.

methods.name: load_branch_decorations
methods.description: Loads decorations specifically for branch references.

methods.name: show_parents
methods.description: Displays parent commits of a given commit.

methods.name: show_children
methods.description: Displays child commits of a given commit.

methods.name: current_pointed_by_HEAD
methods.description: Finds the decoration for the current branch pointed to by HEAD.

methods.name: show_name
methods.description: Adds a reference name to a string buffer, formatted based on decoration flags.

methods.name: format_decorations
methods.description: Formats and appends decorations for a commit into a string buffer, with optional color.

methods.name: show_decorations
methods.description: Displays decorations for a commit if enabled.

methods.name: fmt_output_subject
methods.description: Formats the subject line for commit output.

methods.name: fmt_output_commit
methods.description: Formats the full commit output filename.

methods.name: fmt_output_email_subject
methods.description: Formats the email subject line for a commit.

methods.name: log_write_email_headers
methods.description: Writes email headers for a commit log, including MIME parts and references.

methods.name: show_sig_lines
methods.description: Displays signature verification lines with color coding.

methods.name: show_signature
methods.description: Verifies and displays the signature of a commit.

methods.name: which_parent
methods.description: Finds the index of a parent commit in a commit's parent list.

methods.name: is_common_merge
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a simple merge with exactly two parents.

methods.name: show_one_mergetag
methods.description: Displays information about a mergetag, including verification.

methods.name: show_mergetag
methods.description: Iterates over mergetags and displays them.

methods.name: next_commentary_block
methods.description: Adds a separator line in the output.

methods.name: show_diff_of_diff
methods.description: Displays diff of diffs for email or mail format.

methods.name: show_log
methods.description: Displays commit log information, including headers, decorations, and message.

methods.name: log_tree_diff_flush
methods.description: Finalizes and outputs the diff for a revision.

methods.name: do_diff_combined
methods.description: Performs a combined diff for merge commits.

methods.name: setup_additional_headers
methods.description: Prepares additional headers for diff output based on pathspec.

methods.name: cleanup_additional_headers
methods.description: Cleans up additional headers after diff output.

methods.name: do_remerge_diff
methods.description: Performs a re-merge diff between two parent commits.

methods.name: log_tree_diff
methods.description: Computes and displays the diff of a commit, handling merges and root commits.

methods.name: log_tree_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit log with optional decorations, signatures, and diff.
